Sources: Eldeco Housing & Industries stock-exchange filings and investor call, UP RERA project records (via Aurum PropTech's RERA mirror), HDFC Capital–Eldeco announcement, IIFL company profile, and project listings where marked. Independent guide by DSD Properties — we are not affiliated with Eldeco. Updated: 19 October 2026.

Key Facts (updated 19 October 2026)

  • Eldeco started in 1975 as Eldeco Construction Pvt Ltd. Its Lucknow business is run by Eldeco Housing & Industries Ltd, incorporated in 1985 and listed on the BSE and NSE (IIFL company profile).
  • Chairman & MD: Pankaj Bajaj (Eldeco investor call, 11 Feb 2026).
  • FY 2025-26 (company-reported): bookings ₹743.9 crore, up 120% on the previous year; net profit ₹24.3 crore (FY26 results summary, 25 May 2026).
  • Current Lucknow projects: Trinity (Gomti Nagar Extension, RERA due Sep 2028), Skywalk (due Oct 2029) and Solano Gardens (launched Jan 2026) (RERA record, RERA record, Eldeco investor call, 11 Feb 2026).
  • Some projects are registered by a project company, not the listed firm — Trinity's RERA promoter is Eldeco Inception Buildtech Pvt Ltd (RERA record).

Eldeco is one of the oldest developer names in Lucknow — you will see it on townships, apartments and plotted colonies across the city, from Gomti Nagar Extension to Kanpur Road. This guide explains, in simple words, who Eldeco is, how its companies are organised, how it is doing financially, what it is building in Lucknow right now, and what you should check before you buy. Every fact links to its source; where we rely on a listing or on the company's own claim, we say so.

Who is Eldeco? (in simple words)

The Eldeco Group was started in 1975 as Eldeco Construction Pvt Ltd, founded by S K Garg, a civil-engineering lecturer turned businessman (IIFL company profile). The listed company, Eldeco Housing & Industries Ltd, was incorporated in 1985 and is described as a leading real estate developer in Lucknow, building townships, homes, commercial property and developed plots (IIFL company profile).

Today, two companies carry the Eldeco name, and it helps to know the difference:

CompanyWhat it isWhere it worksSource
Eldeco Housing & Industries LtdListed on the BSE and NSE; incorporated in 1985Lucknow — this is the company behind most Eldeco projects you see in the cityIIFL company profile
Eldeco Infrastructure & Properties LtdUnlisted group companyOther North Indian cities; in April 2025 it set up a ₹1,500 crore platform with HDFC Capital for 18 projects in Panipat, Sonipat, Rudrapur, Ludhiana, Kasauli and RishikeshHDFC Capital–Eldeco announcement, 14 Apr 2025

Both are led by Pankaj Bajaj, Chairman & Managing Director (Eldeco investor call, 11 Feb 2026, HDFC Capital–Eldeco announcement, 14 Apr 2025). The group says it has delivered over 200 projects; in April 2025 it put its delivered area at over 60 million sq ft (HDFC Capital–Eldeco announcement, 14 Apr 2025). These are the group's own figures.

What this means for you

A listed company has to publish its accounts and results every quarter, so you can see how Eldeco Housing is doing. But each project is registered on RERA by a specific company — sometimes the listed firm, sometimes a separate project company. Your agreement must be with the company named on your project's RERA record.

Eldeco Solano Gardens — the newest launch

Launched in January 2026, Solano Gardens is a phased development of villas, plots and group housing that Eldeco values at over ₹1,000 crore. In the February 2026 call it reported about ₹350 crore booked in the first phase and plot prices of about ₹6,000 per sq ft (Eldeco investor call, 11 Feb 2026). By the end of FY26 it reported 343 of the 433 launched units sold, worth about ₹384.5 crore (FY26 results summary, 25 May 2026). A property listing puts it on New Jail Road, on about 52 acres (listing) — confirm the land area and RERA details for your phase on up-rera.in.

Eldeco Trinity and Skywalk — what the RERA carpet areas say

RERA records carpet area — the usable floor inside the flat. For Trinity, a 4 BHK is 181.53 sq m (about 1,954 sq ft) and 3 BHKs range from 120.12 to 150.04 sq m (about 1,293–1,615 sq ft) (RERA record). For Skywalk, 3 BHKs are about 119.6 sq m (about 1,287 sq ft) and 2 BHKs 67.41–87.90 sq m (about 726–946 sq ft) (RERA record). Advertised sizes are usually super area and will be larger — compare prices on carpet area.

Eldeco's record — strengths and what to check

✓ Five decades in the business
The group dates to 1975; the listed company was incorporated in 1985 (IIFL company profile).
✓ Listed and audited
Eldeco Housing & Industries publishes quarterly results and holds investor calls (Eldeco investor call, 11 Feb 2026).
✓ Recent completions
East End at Shaurya is listed as completed on RERA (15 Mar 2026) and Imperia Phase 2 received its completion certificate in FY26 (RERA record, FY26 results summary, 25 May 2026).
✓ More cash than debt
About ₹180 crore cash against about ₹106 crore debt in February 2026 (Eldeco investor call, 11 Feb 2026).

Check before you pay

  • Which company is the RERA promoter of your project — the listed firm or a project company such as Eldeco Inception Buildtech.
  • The RERA completion date of your tower or phase, and the latest quarterly progress report.
  • For Solano Gardens: the RERA number and land area of your phase; plots and villas may be registered separately from group housing.
  • Group-level figures (200+ projects, 60 million sq ft) are the company's own; judge your project by its own record.

Buying from Eldeco in Lucknow? Check these first

  1. RERA number of your exact tower or phase — search it on up-rera.in and note the promoter name.
  2. Agreement and receipts — must be in the name of the RERA promoter.
  3. Carpet area — your agreement must state RERA carpet area; compare price per sq ft of carpet area.
  4. Completion date and progress — check the quarterly progress report before each large instalment.
  5. Plots — confirm the plot number on the approved layout and the building rules for your colony.
  6. Resale in older Eldeco colonies — ask for the seller's registered sale deed, the original allotment or sale deed from Eldeco, society/maintenance dues clearance and an encumbrance certificate; check past registries on IGRSUP.

❓ Frequently Asked Questions

Is Eldeco a Lucknow company?

Eldeco Housing & Industries Ltd, the listed company that runs the Eldeco business in Lucknow, is a Lucknow real estate developer listed on the BSE and NSE (IIFL company profile). The Eldeco name goes back to 1975, when Eldeco Construction Pvt Ltd was set up (IIFL company profile).

Who owns Eldeco?

Pankaj Bajaj is the Chairman and Managing Director of Eldeco Housing & Industries Ltd (Eldeco investor call, 11 Feb 2026) and of the Eldeco Group (HDFC Capital–Eldeco announcement, 14 Apr 2025). As a listed company, its shareholding pattern is published on the BSE and NSE.

What are Eldeco's current projects in Lucknow?

Under construction: Eldeco Trinity (Gomti Nagar Extension, due Sep 2028) and Eldeco Skywalk (IIM Road area, due Oct 2029). Launched in January 2026: Eldeco Solano Gardens (villas, plots and group housing). Recently completed: Eldeco East End at Shaurya (RERA completion 15 Mar 2026) and Eldeco Imperia Phase 2 on Kanpur Road (completion certificate in FY26) (RERA record, RERA record, Eldeco investor call, 11 Feb 2026, RERA record, FY26 results summary, 25 May 2026).

Is Eldeco Trinity built by Eldeco Housing & Industries?

The RERA promoter of Eldeco Trinity is Eldeco Inception Buildtech Private Limited (RERA record). Make sure your agreement and payment receipts name the same company as the RERA record.

What is the price of plots in Eldeco Solano Gardens?

In its February 2026 investor call, Eldeco said plots there were priced at about ₹6,000 per sq ft (Eldeco investor call, 11 Feb 2026). Prices change — ask for the current price list and the RERA record before booking.

Is Eldeco financially stable?

Its own reported numbers for FY 2025-26: bookings of ₹743.9 crore, collections of ₹352.1 crore and net profit of ₹24.3 crore (FY26 results summary, 25 May 2026). In February 2026 it reported about ₹180 crore of cash against about ₹106 crore of debt, with much of the cash held in RERA project accounts (Eldeco investor call, 11 Feb 2026). Financial health helps, but always check your own project's RERA progress.
